Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
For the last few days I have been rebuilding the website to include most of the information contained on the old vekn.net.

The reconstruction is far from complete, but feel free to report any broken links, missing sections, etc. you can spot.

The "What is V:TES?" section has been totally changed, and now displays the articles Brett Schofield wrote about that subject: www.vekn.net/what-is-v-tes

So if you have any suggestions about new sections, articles, information updates, etc., please let me know.

V:EKN Website Coordinator

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
I was cruising around our site and noticed the following:

www.vekn.net/v-ekn-faq

4.13 Where can I purchase V:TES cards?
Europe: From Walch & Nusser Game Distributors.
Rest of the world: From Rose Tatu Productions.

The Europe info ain't up to date any more as W&N closed down.
However, I can tell that Fantasiapelit, who already did have a wide selection of VTES material, purchased more or less the remainder of W&N stock. So perhaps it might be a good idea to change the name/link:
www.fantasiapelit.com

Also, I'm not absolutely sure if Rose Tatu Productions are selling VTES any more. Or rather if it is nowadays mainly restricted to just singles and promos. Might want to check with David on that...

Finnish  Politics!
